first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence links shorter onboarding and fewer signup requirements to improved activation and time-to-value. Verify those records before testing a narrowly scoped simplification, while monitoring qualified activation and downstream retention so completion gains do not reduce long-term revenue quality. Avoid promotional pricing because it previously harmed 30-day retention.

final.rationale: Run a standard, segmented onboarding-shortening experiment focused on self-serve accounts. The verified record directly addresses the 4% completion decline and shows improved completion, faster time-to-value, and higher 30-day retention. Use signup-field reduction only as a secondary measured variant for SMBs, since it improved qualified revenue but slightly reduced retention and was not validated beyond SMB. Monitor activation, qualified revenue, and 30-day retention before rollout; do not use promotional pricing because its prior retention harm conflicts with the sustainable-revenue objective.
